- **`9551:78221`** = "Recently Viewed - desktop" (full page composition: nav, title-and-link header, 5-7 product-card rows, footer)
- **`9560:137688`** = "Recently Viewed - tablet"
- **`9560:138459`** = "Recently Viewed - mobile"

The header row had a real, confirmed bug — wrong padding at every breakpoint (was 32px vertical uniformly + either zero or asymmetric-180px horizontal, depending on breakpoint). Now fixed and committed in `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmRecentlyViewedGrid/zimmRecentlyViewedGrid.css.ts` (commit `b4326db`): Desktop 40px all four sides symmetric; Tablet/Mobile 32px horizontal + 20px vertical symmetric — both confirmed against `9551:110758` (Desktop title-and-link)/`9560:137691` (Tablet)/`9560:138462` (Mobile), which are children of the three page frames above. **Re-verify this fix holds up under a fuller traversal** of the same three page frames — if a deeper read disagrees, that's worth surfacing, not silently reconciling.

Row gap (64px, `--zimm-scale-1600`), Desktop column count (4), horizontal card gap (96px, `GRID_CARD_GAP` — note: produced by `columnGap` on a fixed-width grid in code vs. Figma's own `justify-between`, so only matches exactly at exactly 1440px viewport width, a known and already-documented divergence, not a new finding).

1. **Full card content styling** — name text style, price text style (including was/now sale-price treatment if any card in these frames shows it), badge rendering (position/style, if any card shows one), size-chip rendering if visible, bag/add-to-cart icon position and style, internal card padding — cross-check byte-for-byte against what PLP's own already-shipped card looks like, since SFCC-236's AC requires "same behavior as PLP card" — a real divergence here is a bug, not a style preference.
2. **Item count** — exact text style (previously assumed same `heading3` as the title — verify this directly rather than trust the assumption), exact spacing from the title, and confirm the previously-flagged oddity (the item-count layer is literally named "Link" in Figma, suggesting a copy-paste artifact) doesn't indicate an actual missed interactive/link behavior anywhere in these three page frames.
3. **Tablet/Mobile column counts** — previously NOT independently re-confirmed (no corroborating node found last time); this pass has the full page frames again, so check directly: how many product cards actually appear per row in the Tablet and Mobile page compositions? Confirm or refute the current code's `GRID_COLUMNS_TABLET = 3` / `GRID_COLUMNS_BASE = 2`.
4. **Empty state** — previously not found in the given node set at all. Check whether these three page frames (or any hidden/alternate variant reachable from them) show an empty/zero-history state, and if so what it actually looks like, to compare against `overrides/app/pages/recentlyViewed/index.tsx`'s own `EmptyRecentlyViewed` (built from the `EmptyCart` pattern with no confirmed Figma spec at the time).
5. **Full layout** — page-level padding/margins around the whole grid (distinct from the grid's own internal header/card padding), vertical spacing between the grid and the surrounding page chrome (nav/footer visible in these frames).

## Current implementation to compare against

- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmRecentlyViewedGrid/index.tsx` + `.css.ts` (just-fixed header, see above)
- `overrides/app/pages/recentlyViewed/index.tsx` — page container, title/item-count copy, empty state
- `overrides/app/components/ui-kits/organisms/zimmProductCard/index.tsx` (`plp` variation), `zimmProductCardContent/index.tsx`, `zimmProductCardMedia/index.tsx` — the actual card rendering, same components PLP uses

## Report format

Structured, most-severe/most-confident first. CONFIRMED (certain) vs. PLAUSIBLE (looks wrong, couldn't fully verify — say why) vs. Could-not-verify (rate-limited, dead node, ambiguous mapping). For each finding: exact Figma node + value, exact file:line + current value, concrete visual consequence. Explicitly state whether the header fix holds up under this fuller traversal. Do not fix anything — audit only. Keep the report tight — bullets, not prose essays per finding.

## CONFIRMED — new bug this deeper pass found (prior pass only checked Desktop)

**Card gap is wrong at Tablet and Mobile — code applies one fixed 96px everywhere; Figma varies it per breakpoint, both values bound to real Figma variables:**
- Desktop: 96px — correct, matches code (`GRID_CARD_GAP`), re-confirmed.
- Tablet (`9560:137692`, 3 cards, 834px row): gap = 80px, bound to real Figma variable `alias/space/2000`. Code has no breakpoint override for `columnGap` at all — Tablet gets the same 96px as Desktop, wrong by 16px per gap.
- Mobile (`9560:138463`, 2×2 cards): gap = 40px, bound to real Figma variable `alias/space/gap/1000`. Same issue — code applies 96px, wrong by 56px per gap, the larger of the two misses.

Both 80px and 40px are real, named, on-token values (`spacing['5xl']`=80px, `spacing['3xl']`=40px in this repo's own `foundation/spacing.ts`) — not pending-token values like `GRID_CARD_GAP` itself.

## Header fix — holds up, independently re-confirmed via a fuller read

Desktop `title-and-link` (`9551:110758`): Content frame at x=40/y=40 inside a 1440×104 bar, content width 1360 (=1440-40-40, symmetric), content height 24 (104-40-40). Exactly matches the committed fix. Tablet/Mobile header total height = 64px on both (=20+24+20), also matching. No discrepancy found.

## CONFIRMED correct, not bugs (re-confirmed, not new)

- Desktop: 4 columns, 288px cards, 64px row gap — all match.
- **Tablet 3-column and Mobile 2-column counts, previously unconfirmed — now independently verified correct** from the real page frames (Tablet: 3 cards/row exactly; Mobile: 2×2 grid per "Product Card Group" instance, 64px internal row gap, consistent with the existing row-gap token).
- Product-name and Price text specs (family/weight/size/line-height) match this repo's own registered `productNames`/`body2Strong` text styles exactly — cross-checked against `foundation/typography.ts` directly. No divergence found; this is shared `ZimmProductCardContent` code already validated on PLP, not Full-History-specific.

## PLAUSIBLE — not fully verified

- A "Footer Primary" section with a centered 139×52 "Button" appears directly below the last product-card row on all three breakpoints, before the site's real Footer. Purpose/label not confirmed — could be generic site-wide chrome unrelated to Recently Viewed, or an unbuilt "Load More" feature. Didn't chase further; worth a deliberate look if it's the latter.
- Text-transform/case (e.g. whether the product name renders uppercase) and letter-spacing weren't checked — `get_variable_defs` doesn't surface those; would need a screenshot or `get_design_context` pull.
